g.title: HR_COMPGRIDROW
g.text: Competency Grid Row - This represents the link between Competencies and Grid.
The Compentency Grid to be used
Indicates the weighting as a percentage
A number indicating the importance of the entity it relates to.
This field is used to override the standard competency description within a specific grid.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_COMPGRID
g.text: Competency Grid - Defines a list of competencies and, optionally, enables a weight to be associated.
The validity start date for an historical situation.
The validity end date for an historical situation.
The name of the Competency Grid.
The description of the Competency Grid.
This field indicate which rating scale will be used for the evaluation.
Activate this flag to include all questions from the grid's questionnaire in the appraisal review, including those that have not been linked with any competency.
Identify which assessment component is linked to this section

When true, the grid will be associated to an Assessment Component. For example, when evaluating the job suitability for a person, if a Grid mapped with an Assessment Component is attached to the Job, then the system will calculate an additional partial score for the Grid, linked to its Assessment Component.
Indicates the date and time of creation

Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_APPRCOMPSECROW
g.text: Appraisal Competency Section Row - This entity represents a single competency review.
This is the numeric score that comes from a manual adjustment. By default, it is equal to the calculated score and can be changed by authorised users.
This is the score expressed as a percentage.
This is the percentage score that comes from a manual adjustment. By default, it is equal to the calculated percentage score and can be changed by authorised users.
